items.informal_name: Zero Coefficients for Degrees ≥ n in Polynomials from Finite Sequences
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R] {n i : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R),
  n ≤ i → ((Polynomial.ofFn n) v).coeff i = 0
items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $n$ and $i$, and a function $v : \text{Fin } n \to R$, if $i \geq n$, then the coefficient of $X^i$ in the polynomial constructed by $\text{ofFn } n \, v$ is zero. This follows from the fact that $\text{ofFn } n \, v$ generates a polynomial with nonzero coefficients only for degrees strictly less than $n$.

items.informal_name: Submodule of polynomials of degree less than n
items.type: (R : Type u) → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Submodule R (Polynomial R)
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ R $ and natural number $ n $, this is the submodule of $ R[X] $ consisting of all polynomials whose coefficients vanish for all degrees $ \geq n $. It is defined as the intersection over all $ k \geq n $ of the kernels of the linear maps extracting the $ k $-th coefficient, i.e., $ \bigcap_{k \geq n} \{f \in R[X] \mid \text{coeff}_{X^k}(f) = 0\} $.
